purpose: Production startup integration of the approved matte arcade preview; current-time lighting variants.

stages.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the mosque arcade composition already liked by the user. Image 2 is the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE, an existing approved Nur Islam app illustration. Match Image 2's smooth clean matte 3D material and simplified shape language much more faithfully.
Keep Image 1's portrait framing, large quiet deep emerald wall in the middle, close ivory column on the extreme left, arch on the right, small glimpse of a teal dome outside at lower right, warm afternoon light and uncluttered floor. Preserve the central dark-green text-safe area x20%-80%, y12%-76%.
Restyle the ENTIRE environment as a cohesive handcrafted 3D illustration using the same visual grammar as Image 2. Model the columns, capitals, arch and cornice as simple solid cream forms with rounded bevels and clean silhouettes, few broad geometric tiers, no carved microdetail. The central wall must be smooth satin emerald like the teal dome material in Image 2. Floor: a few large smooth warm cream slabs, with very soft clean reflections and broad shadows. Foliage: reduce to just a few clearly modeled matte olive-green leaves near the top-left margin and very small outside-right sprig. Simplify the dome and background architecture to the same sculpted 3D quality as Image 2.
CRITICAL: remove ALL stone grain, marble veins, plaster noise, weathering, fine scratches, photographic leaf texture, tiny twigs, complex cast leaf shadows and realistic masonry. Every surface is smooth and untextured, with gentle studio-like gradients and ambient occlusion that describes the solid 3D shapes. Warm light should be broad and soft. No grain or added noise anywhere. Mature refined 3D illustration, restrained colors and proportions, not a children's toy, not a photorealistic architectural photograph, not flat vector art.
Do not alter the spacious text-safe composition. No text, letters, UI, books, people, logos, symbols or new decorative objects. One finished portrait image.

Use case: lighting-weather. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the approved final smooth matte 3D arcade for the Nur Islam opening. Make ONE FAJR lighting variant. Preserve EXACTLY its portrait 2:3 framing, camera position, geometry, column and arch shapes, green bands, simplified smooth leaf shapes, distant dome and original object positions. Keep the entire central wall smooth and empty, x20%-80% y12%-76%, for app text in cream. Keep the same refined clean 3D illustration family with smooth untextured surfaces and soft broad shading, no photography or stone texture. Change ONLY lighting and time of day: PRE-DAWN: indigo light outdoors, muted rose at the distant horizon glimpsed at far right. Cream columns in soft cool blue dawn shade, discreet warm gold illumination from the arcade. Emerald wall remains deep dark green with a soft gentle glow. No sun disk. No added lamps/objects, no words, no logo, no UI, no books or people. Do not alter architecture or zoom. One finished portrait image.
